competing_explanation: The 30-day full-refund window may be outdated, limited to specific product categories, or replaced by a shorter/longer window or store-credit-only policy.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy allows standard items to be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence shows a different return window, a different start date, or that standard items do not qualify for a full refund within 30 days.
